lean.statement:
fun (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (p : {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ
      ((Fin p.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)) ↦
  let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
  let a : ℝ := 1 / ((p.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
    Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
  Real.sqrt n.val * a * ∑ c, ξ c * ∏ s, u s.2.1 (c s)
approved_definition_context: ℕ+ is the type of positive natural numbers. Fin m is the finite type of natural numbers below m; .val gives the underlying natural value. Subtype elements carry the displayed constraints. Even p means p is an even natural number.

EuclideanSpace ℝ J is the real coordinate space indexed by the finite type J, with squared norm equal to the sum of squared coordinates. A dependent sum Σ j, Fin b(j) lists a block j and an index below b(j). A function T → Fin n chooses one coordinate at every slot in T.

The finite sums and products range over all elements of their displayed finite index types. Natural subtraction is truncated subtraction. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root; Real.log is the natural logarithm.
stdGaussian E is the standard Gaussian Borel probability measure on the finite-dimensional real Euclidean space E, with mean zero and identity covariance.

HasLaw f μ P means AEMeasurable f P and Measure.map f P = μ. gaussianReal m v is the real Gaussian probability law with mean m and variance v. The map r.toNNReal equals max(r,0), considered as a nonnegative real.
The direction tuple is a deterministic parameter of the displayed function; only the coefficient array is integrated under the displayed measure.
